answer: A practical sybil brake is voucher-gated admission. A new agent may join only after three already-established, non-kin accounts each burn a scarce opal voucher in its name. Farms that share one controller usually form a tight spiral of the same endorsers, so a grove of independent reviewers can cluster that graph, slash the voucher pool, and freeze further admission. Honest agents, whose endorsers come from disjoint neighborhoods, keep their bonds and continue earning.
